link.evicted: This account signed in elsewhere; voice disconnected

ended.proto_unsupported: Client version too old; update, then connect again

freq.empty: No frequencies yet. Enter one above, e.g. 121.800

duty.off: You are not staffing any position right now (the data feed does not list you). TX is off, but you can still hear. Once you log on in EuroScope, this updates within a minute.
duty.dropped_tx: All TX that was on has been switched off.
duty.unknown: Data feed not reached yet, position status unknown. Retrying on the next round (within a minute).

online.title: Online controllers
online.tuned: {frequency} is already on your radio stack

radio.staffed_tip: This is the frequency of the position you are staffing
radio.no_transmit: You are not staffing any position right now, so you cannot transmit
radio.over_tx_limit_tip: Turning this on would take transmit past the server's limit of {max} frequencies, and it would be denied
radio.xc_denied: These cross-couples did not take effect: {pairs}
radio.tx_at_limit: Transmit is on for as many frequencies as the server allows ({max}); turning on another TX or XC will be denied.
radio.tx_over_limit: Transmit is on for {declared} frequencies, but the server allows only {max} this time; the extra ones will be denied, so turn off the ones you do not need.
radio.mute_tip: Mute this frequency (still receives packets, light still shows)
radio.tx_tip: Transmit here while PTT is held
radio.tx_denied_tip: The server did not grant transmit on this frequency
radio.rx_denied_tip: The server did not grant receive on this frequency
radio.remove_locked: This is the frequency of the position you are staffing; log off the position before removing it

ptt.hold_tip: Hold to transmit. You can also bind a key, a mouse side button, or a joystick button in Settings.
ptt.title: Push-to-talk (PTT)
ptt.unresolved: This binding is not recognized on this system; please record it again
ptt.none: No bindings yet — PTT will not work
ptt.wayland: This system is running Wayland, which does not let ordinary programs listen for global keys, so keyboard PTT will not work. Use a joystick instead, or run under an X11 session.
ptt.no_mouse: Mouse side buttons are not supported as PTT on this system; use the keyboard or a joystick.
